components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--color-night, #0a0a0a); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line, #262626); color: var(--color-paper, #f2f2f0); transition: background-color 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; } .ds-mark { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-paper, #f2f2f0); text-decoration: none; } .ds-mark span { color: var(--color-accent, #ff6a3d); } .ds-header-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; } .ds-locale { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-paper-3, #8b8b87); } .ds-locale button { background: none; border: 0; padding: 8px 4px; font: inherit; letter-spacing: inherit; text-transform: inherit; color: var(--color-paper-3, #8b8b87); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-locale button:hover, .ds-locale button.is-active { color: var(--color-paper, #f2f2f0); } .ds-pill { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.6; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-paper, #f2f2f0); color: var(--color-night, #0a0a0a); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.3s; } .ds-pill:hover { background: var(--color-accent, #ff6a3d); } .ds-header a:focus-visible, .ds-header button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #ff6a3d); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Ink Link (drawn)
components.description: The page's link: paper text with a hand-drawn vermilion SVG underline that draws once in view and redraws on hover; text turns vermilion on hover.
components.html: Builds data systems for a living.
components.css: .ds-ink-p { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif); font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--color-paper-2, #a8a8a4); background: var(--color-night, #0a0a0a); padding: 24px; margin: 0; } .ds-ink { position: relative; display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--color-paper, #f2f2f0); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-ink:hover, .ds-ink:focus-visible { color: var(--color-accent, #ff6a3d); } .ds-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #ff6a3d); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-ink-wrap { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -0.32em; height: 0.42em; pointer-events: none; } .ds-ink-wrap svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; } .ds-scribble { stroke-dasharray: 1; stroke-dashoffset: 1; } .ds-ink.is-drawn .ds-scribble { animation: ds-scribble 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.15s both; } .ds-ink:hover .ds-scribble, .ds-ink:focus-visible .ds-scribble { animation: ds-scribble 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0s both; } @keyframes ds-scribble { from { stroke-dashoffset: 1; } to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-scribble { stroke-dashoffset: 0; animation: none !important; } }

components.name: Ink Link (wrap)
components.description: For links inside long prose that must break across lines: the native wavy underline, inked to vermilion once seen.
components.html: Most of the work sits between operations and data, in the reporting systems a mining company runs on every morning, and in the tools around them.
components.css: .ds-wavy-p { max-width: 62ch; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif); font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--color-paper-2, #a8a8a4); background: var(--color-night, #0a0a0a); padding: 24px; margin: 0; } .ds-wavy { color: var(--color-paper, #f2f2f0); text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-style: wavy; text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; text-underline-offset: 0.3em; text-decoration-color: transparent; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), text-decoration-color 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.15s; } .ds-wavy.is-drawn { text-decoration-color: var(--color-accent, #ff6a3d); } .ds-wavy:hover { color: var(--color-accent, #ff6a3d); } .ds-wavy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #ff6a3d); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-cards { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 24px; background: var(--color-night, #0a0a0a); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif); } .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #262626); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; color: var(--color-paper, #f2f2f0); transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { background: var(--color-paper, #f2f2f0); border-color: var(--color-paper, #f2f2f0); color: var(--color-night, #0a0a0a); } .ds-card-name { font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-card-items { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 16px; margin: 12px 0 0; } .ds-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--color-paper-2, #a8a8a4); transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover .ds-item { color: rgb(10 10 10 / 0.75); } .ds-item svg, .ds-slot { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-slot { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-slot span { width: 3px; height: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; opacity: 0.6; }

components.css: .ds-sticker-stage { background: var(--color-night, #0a0a0a); padding: 40px; } .ds-sticker { width: min(19rem, 72vw); margin: 0; padding: 8px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--color-paper, #f2f2f0); box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -30px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9); transform: rotate(4deg); transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-sticker:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) translateY(-4px); } .ds-sticker-photo { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; border-radius: 14px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #c99a7a, #6b5446 55%, #2c2724); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sticker { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The page is a personal index: one column of type on a black page, read top to bottom like a list of what one engineer has done and where to find it. Type carries everything. There are no panels, no surfaces stacked on surfaces, no illustration; structure comes from hairlines, a fixed left column for headings, and the contrast between the sans text and a small uppercase mono voice for labels, dates and link rows.

One colour does all the pointing. Vermilion appears as a line drawn by hand under the words that lead somewhere, as the hover colour of those words, and in the browser chrome that belongs to the reader (selection, focus ring, scrollbar thumb). Everything else is night, paper and two quieter greys of paper. Colour photography is the second, deliberate exception to the monochrome: the portrait and the project screenshots are shown in full colour, framed so they read as objects placed on the page.

Speed is part of the look. Scroll is native, nothing is blurred, nothing is tied to scroll position, and every motion is a one-shot CSS transition or animation: an underline that draws itself, a section rule that extends once, a corner grid that fades in, a row that inverts under the pointer. All text is present at first paint. Confirmed rejections: glassmorphism and blur (rejected by the owner as slow, "el scroll lento, se pega"), smooth-scroll libraries, and scroll-scrubbed animation.
keyCharacteristics: Black ground, paper text, one vermilion accent reserved for things that open.
Geist for everything read; Geist Mono, small and uppercase, for everything labelled.
Every section: a hairline across the top, the heading in a 19rem left column, content to the right.
Hover states invert to paper; links shift to vermilion.
Hand-drawn SVG underlines that draw once on arrival and redraw on hover.
Colour only in photographs: the portrait as a crooked white-framed sticker, screenshots in hairline frames.
One-shot CSS motion only; measured whole-page scroll p95 under 9ms per frame with no long animation frames.

rules.name: The Only-What-Opens Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks only things that open: links, the email pill, focus, selection, the scrollbar. It is never a heading colour, never a resting fill, never a status. The "ongoing" dot in the work list is paper, not vermilion.

rules.name: The Two Exceptions Rule
rules.body: Photography is shown in full natural colour (the portrait and every project screenshot); it is the only colour on the page besides vermilion. Brand logos are not: technology marks are drawn in the text colour.

rules.name: The Inverted Hover Rule
rules.body: On hover a row or card turns paper and its text turns night; its secondary text drops to night at 60–80% opacity. No other hover fill exists.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Sans is for what is read, mono is for what is labelled or listed. There is one mono style (the label); do not create a second size or weight of it.

rules.name: The Tight-Top Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows: -0.04em on the name, -0.035em on headings, -0.03em on project titles, -0.02em on row titles and the lead; body text is untracked; only the mono label is opened up (+0.08em).

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: The portrait sticker is the only element with a shadow. Rows, cards, frames and the header are flat.

rules.name: The Solid Header Rule
rules.body: The header is never translucent or blurred; past 40px of scroll it is solid night.

dos: Do keep vermilion on things that open: drawn underlines, link hover text, the email pill's hover fill, the focus ring, text selection and the scrollbar thumb.
Do open every section with the Section pattern: a top hairline that draws once, the heading in the 19rem left column, the content on the right; stack below 1024px.
Do set every label, date, tech list and link row in the single mono label style (Geist Mono 500, 0.8125rem, 0.08em, uppercase), with tabular figures for numbers.
Do underline short links with the drawn scribble and links inside wrapping prose with the wavy variant.
Do express hover as an inversion to paper (200ms) for rows and cards, or as a shift to vermilion (300ms) for links.
Do keep every motion one-shot (on first view or on hover), animating only transform, opacity, stroke-dashoffset or colour, eased with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
Do render all text at first paint; only rules, underlines, the grid and hover states move.
Do show the portrait and project screenshots in full colour, in their frames.
Do honour reduced motion: every scribble and wavy line shown already drawn, every animation and transition effectively instant.
Do draw technology marks in currentColor, with a 3px dot holding the slot when a term has no mark.
donts: Don't use vermilion on headings, resting fills, status indicators or decoration; the "ongoing" dot is paper.
Don't add a second accent colour, tinted surfaces or gradient text.
Don't use backdrop-filter or blur, smooth-scroll libraries such as Lenis, or any animation tied to scroll position; the page must hold scroll p95 under 9ms per frame with no long animation frames.
Don't fade or slide text blocks in on entry; content is never hidden behind an animation.
Don't add shadows beyond the portrait sticker's, or box content into panels; lists are ruled with hairlines.
Don't show technology logos in their brand colours.
Don't make the header translucent; past 40px it is solid night.
